title: புதிய சொகுசு வாகனம் வாங்கும் யோகம் (New Luxury Vehicle Acquisition)
description: Strong Venus + Rahu conjunction grants acquisition of brand-new luxury 4-wheelers and high-end vehicles.

title: பழைய வாகனம் வாங்குதல் (Used / Second-hand Vehicle)
description: Venus connecting with Saturn or Ketu leads to purchasing second-hand or pre-owned vehicles, with recurring minor breakdowns.

title: ராசிகளின் கால்களும் வாகன வகைகளும் (Signs Legs and Vehicle Types)
description: 2-legged signs = 2-wheelers; 3-count signs = 3-wheelers / autos; 4-legged signs = cars/4-wheelers; 8-legged signs = heavy transport vehicles.
